description: Loan amortization schedule with optional payment dates client and server side from freedailypro

firstPaymentDate.description: Optional date the first payment is due, as YYYY-MM-DD. Adds a date to every schedule row and returns firstPaymentDate, lastPaymentDate and payoffDate. It only labels the schedule; the amounts do not change. A payment day of 29 to 31 moves to the last day of shorter months.

principal.description: The principal (the starting loan or investment amount).
